exceptions.rationale: The advisory requires Windows encoded-backslash static serving. FactoryWager MCP and portal workloads run on macOS/Linux and do not expose @hono/node-server serveStatic on Windows. Re-evaluate when the SDK accepts @hono/node-server 2.x.

exceptions.scope: Transitive development dependency through ESLint minimatch 3.
exceptions.rationale: The vulnerable 1.x instance is used only by local/CI lint path matching and never receives remote or tenant-controlled glob patterns. The patched 5.x package is ESM and cannot safely replace minimatch 3's CommonJS dependency.

The advisory affects only unstable React Server Components APIs. Sports Terminal uses BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Link, and NavLink and has no RSC runtime. React Router 8.3 removes react-router-dom, so remediation requires an owned migration rather than an unsafe forced override.
